title: catchup-brief-kavita-singh-may20-2026
content:
Purpose: quick weekly 1:1 with Miguel (IC on runtime batching refactor). Keep ~30m. Focus: unblock, career calibration, test/rollout plan alignment.

Top priorities to cover (order):
- Status snapshot (5m): what shipped since last 1:1, quick numbers
  - PR 1823 merged to staging (perf harness run started) — note: still seeing +6% p99 under heavy load vs baseline.
  - Heatmap: p50 ~ stable, p95 improved 12%, p99 regressed slightly. Need to dig into long-tail.
  - Cost: expected token cost down ~8% in microbench; cluster cost estimate for next quarter attached (RD-4127).

- Current blockers (10m): be explicit, decide immediate owner(s)
  - KV cache eviction bug: reproducer in integ tests but not in local; Miguel suspects race in async flush path. ACTION: Miguel to open a minimal repro (deadline: 2026-05-22).
  - E2E staging failures on long-context tests (seq len > 8k): maybe kernel selection fallback mismatch. ACTION: pair with Alex (infra) Thursday 10am.
  - Rollout gating: need rollback playbook for dedicated (private) customers — draft exists but missing fail-open steps. ACTION: Kavita to propose additions by Friday.

- Design quickwins + tradeoffs (7m):
  - Short-term: force LRU on KV eviction for 2-week hotfix vs larger refactor later. Pros/cons (latency vs memory).
  - Mid-term: revisit kernel selection heuristics — add a low-overhead telemetry tag to trace path taken per request. Miguel to prototype telemetry flag in PR 1830.

- Career / growth check (5m):
  - Miguel: interest in IC ladder step to senior staff? He seemed hesitant last time. Ask about recent leadership moments (mentorship, cross-team syncs).
  - Feedback to give: good ownership on batching work; need clearer status signals during rollouts (re: on-call impact).
  - Next step: encourage one talk in tech lunch (30m) about batching heuristics. ACTION: Miguel to schedule for June.

- Follow-ups and housekeeping (3m):
  - Confirm next 1:1 cadence (keep weekly for next quarter).
  - Remind about running the perf harness before pushing big changes to canary.

Notes to self (scratch):
- Start meeting by acknowledging last week's long work hours — quick personal check-in.
- Avoid deep debugging in 1:1; if we need to, schedule a focused pairing session after meeting.
- Keep tone coaching; Miguel defers when unclear; ask direct questions: "What do you need me to clear?"

Open questions I want answers to in the meeting:
- Can you reproduce KV eviction locally? If not, what infra difference blocks it?
- Which customer (if any) would hit >8k seq in the next month? Impacts rollout order.
- Are there any PRs you feel blocked on because of code review backlog?

Action items (explicit) to write in follow-up email after 1:1:
- Miguel: repo with minimal KV repro (due 2026-05-22) — link + short steps.
- Miguel + Alex: pairing session for long-context staging failures (scheduled Thu 10am).
- Kavita: add fail-open steps to dedicated rollback playbook (due 2026-05-22).
- Miguel: draft tech-lunch talk outline for June, share by 2026-05-28.
- Both: sync on perf harness runs and document thresholds for canary promotion.

References / context links I might paste in chat:
- GH PR 1823: https://github.com/redwood-inference/serving-runtime/pull/1823
- Jira RD-4127: latency/cost estimate for batching rollout
- Slack convo 2026-05-14 (thread): https://slack-redwood/archives/C12345/p1623456789000

End of doc — quick checklist before meeting:
- [ ] share agenda 1h before
- [ ] attach perf dashboard snippet (last 24h)
- [ ] set calendar invite with Google Meet link
- [ ] bring up career 1 question

Random scratch lines (may delete):
- Think about enabling a small-scale canary in EU region only to reduce blast radius.
- Who owns the alert for KV size spike? (SRE?)
